methods.name: advance
methods.summary: Advances the buffer by `additional` bits

methods.name: append
methods.summary: Appends a boolean `v` into the buffer

methods.name: append_buffer
methods.summary: Append [`BooleanBuffer`] to this [`BooleanBufferBuilder`]

methods.name: append_n
methods.signature: fn append_n(&mut self, additional: usize, v: bool)
methods.summary: Appends n `additional` bits of value `v` into the buffer

methods.name: append_packed_range
methods.signature: fn append_packed_range(&mut self, range: Range<usize>, to_set: &[u8])
methods.summary: Append `range` bits from `to_set`

methods.name: append_slice
methods.summary: Appends a slice of booleans into the buffer

methods.name: append_word
methods.signature: fn append_word(&mut self, word: u64, count: usize)
methods.summary: Appends the low `count` bits from `word` into the buffer.

methods.name: as_slice
methods.summary: Returns the packed bits

methods.name: as_slice_mut
methods.summary: Returns the packed bits

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Builds a [`BooleanBuffer`] without resetting the builder.

methods.name: capacity
methods.summary: Returns the capacity of the buffer, in bits (not bytes)

methods.name: extend_trusted_len
methods.signature: unsafe fn extend_trusted_len<I>(&mut self, iterator: I) where I: Iterator<Item = bool>
methods.summary: Extends the builder from a trusted length iterator of booleans. # Safety Callers must ensure that `iter` reports an exact size via `size_hint`.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Resets this builder and returns a [`BooleanBuffer`].

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the [BooleanBuffer] without resetting the builder.

methods.name: get_bit
methods.summary: Gets a bit in the buffer at `index`

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if empty

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the length of the buffer

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new `BooleanBufferBuilder` with sufficient space for `capacity` bits (not bytes).

methods.name: new_from_buffer
methods.signature: fn new_from_buffer(buffer: MutableBuffer, len: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new `BooleanBufferBuilder` from [`MutableBuffer`] of `len`

methods.name: reserve
methods.summary: Reserve space to at least `additional` new bits. Capacity will be `>= self.len() + additional`.

methods.name: resize
methods.summary: Resizes the buffer, either truncating its contents (with no change in capacity), or growing it (potentially reallocating it) and writing `false` in the newly available bits.

methods.name: set_bit
methods.signature: fn set_bit(&mut self, index: usize, v: bool)
methods.summary: Sets a bit in the buffer at `index`

methods.name: truncate
methods.summary: Truncates the builder to the given length
